A great way to see the island. blurb: Guests take helicopter tours ranging from 7 to 25 miles over Galveston Island, seeing beaches, the harbor, marine life, and city landmarks. Tours include a beach tour, sea life tour, around the island tour, and a sunset tour. Flights are in Robinson R44 or R66 helicopters with weight limits per passenger and total.
